text:
acme_ops: Hi, we're suddenly getting 429s from our dedicated pool since the plan migration last night. Errors show quota_exceeded for tenant=acme-payments. 80% of recent calls are 429. Can someone triage?
maya_support: sorry to hear that — can you paste the exact error payload and the tenant id? also which model/route you're hitting?
acme_ops: tenant id = tenant_6721, hitting /v1/generate (chat) on dedicated-nyc pool. example error: {
  "status":429,
  "error":"quota_exceeded",
  "detail":"rate limit exceeded"
}
maya_support: thx. I'm pulling logs now. @devin_infra any early ideas?
devin_infra: looking at quota config for tenant_6721 — UI shows 200 rps (configured during plan migrate at ~02:10 UTC). Backend enforcement shows 200/min. suspect unit mapping problem from migration job.
sophie_sre: summary: config was created as "200 rps" in new billing portal but enforcement engine interpreted it as requests-per-minute => effective limit = 200/min = ~3.33 rps. that matches ops spike + 429s.
omar_oncall: interesting — why didn't the dedicated autoscaler spin up more capacity?
devin_infra: autoscaler uses GPU queue metrics (inflight tokens) to scale. Because requests are being rejected at the ingress throttle, they never reach GPU queue, so autoscaler sees low backend load and doesn't scale. classic ingress-throttle -> no-scale situation.
maya_support: do we have quick mitigations before a full fix? customer is production.
devin_infra: immediate options: 1) apply a temporary quota override for tenant_6721 via admin API to the intended value in per_minute units (i.e., set 200/min -> 12000/min to approximate 200 rps), 2) rollback the plan migration metadata for that tenant, or 3) open a hotfix to the rate-conversion job. I'll take (1) and (3).
maya_support: please share exact API calls we can run (I'll coordinate with acme).
devin_infra: run: ```bash
# check current enforcement view
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://admin.redwood.internal/tenants/tenant_6721/quota

# temp override -> set units_per_minute to 12000 (approx 200 rps)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  https://admin.redwood.internal/tenants/tenant_6721/quota/overrides 
  -d '{"source":"support-hotfix","units_per_minute":"12000","reason":"hotfix - unit-mapping migration"}'
```
billing_bot: note: applying overrides will bypass billing checks; must sign-off by billing within 24h.
sophie_sre: I'll create a dashboard panel to watch 429 rate and GPU queue. add a canned alert: 429 rate > 5% for 5m -> paged.
acme_ops: we can accept a short override. please proceed.
devin_infra: started override, will post result. also kicking off migration-fix job to convert any leftover rps->rpm mismatches. ETA ~30m.
deploybot: override applied by maya_support at 2173457102 (id override_8932).
devin_infra: workaround verification: run a small loadtest from your CI: ```bash
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME_KEY" https://api.redwood.prod/dedicated/tenant_6721/v1/generate & done
```
We should see success codes > 200s now instead of 429.
maya_support: acme_ops, can you run that and confirm?
acme_ops: running now — initial check shows error rate dropped to <2% and UX recovered. thanks.
devin_infra: next steps: (A) patch migration job to write explicit units (units_per_second OR units_per_minute) and add conversion sanity checks, (B) backfill conversion for all tenant entries created between 2025-11-02 01:50 and 03:00 UTC, (C) add a dashboard for 'ingress throttle vs autoscaler activity' to detect this pattern. I'll own A+B.
sophie_sre: I'll own C and alerts.
omar_oncall: I'll monitor PG and escalate if 429s tick up. paging policy: if 429s >5% after override expires, auto-rollback and page infra.
maya_support: filing a support follow-up to acme with summary + incident timeline.
acme_ops: appreciate the fast response. please keep me posted once the migration job is patched.
devin_infra: noted. logging action items: override applied (override_8932), patch branch opened (git/p/migrate-quota-units), backfill job queued. Will post PR and runbook.
maya_support: closing loop here — re-open if anything reappears. :white_check_mark:
